readerCopy.body: Responsibility can become much heavier when one mistake feels capable of changing how competence or credibility will be judged. When Saturn conjoins Chiron, duty and sensitivity fuse, making a deadline, review, title, or person with authority press on an old fear that respect depends on getting everything right. The standard may be legitimate while constant self-surveillance is not part of the assignment. The work becomes more manageable when the actual requirement is separated from the fear of what imperfection might supposedly reveal.
